description: This file defines the HttpMethodNotAllowedException class, which is a specialized exception used in the Slim framework to indicate that an HTTP request uses a method that is not allowed for the requested resource. It extends from HttpSpecializedException and includes properties for allowed methods, response code, and message, along with getter and setter methods for allowed methods.

classes.name: HttpMethodNotAllowedException
classes.description: A specialized exception representing HTTP 405 Method Not Allowed errors, allowing setting and retrieving the allowed HTTP methods.

methods.name: getAllowedMethods
methods.description: Returns the list of allowed HTTP methods.

methods.name: setAllowedMethods
methods.description: Sets the list of allowed HTTP methods and updates the exception message accordingly.
